## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

List the checks you ran. State any signed, UI, or system-state validation that was not performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing architecture and toolchain contracts.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated in proportion to the behavior and risk.
- [ ] `scripts/ci/all.sh` was run for code or build changes, or the reason it was not run is documented above.
- [ ] User-visible changes are reflected in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Contract documentation is mirrored under `docs/en/` and `docs/zh/` when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, Team IDs, private Bundle IDs, real network data, signing materials, or unredacted diagnostics are included.
